answer: Proof-of-Stake protocols mitigate Sybil attacks by tying voting power to capital assets rather than identity. By staking tokens, an agent reaches a financial nadir of risk, as malicious behavior triggers slashing. Like a glacier shifting with slow, irresistible force, capital locks prevent rapid identity proliferation. This economic orchard of rewards ensures that the cost of entry remains prohibitive, forcing attackers to bear significant monetary loss for every fake node deployed.
